title: Samsung Electronics expects to win more customers for advanced logic chips
title_zh: 三星电子希望为先进逻辑芯片赢得更多客户
summary: SEOUL, April 30 () - Samsung Electronics said on Thursday it expects to ‌win more deals to manufacture ‌logic chips using its advanced 2 nanometer process ​in the near future, adding it has been in talks with big tech customers regarding the foundry contracts.
summary_zh: 首尔，4 月 30 日 () - 三星电子周四表示，预计在不久的将来将赢得更多使用先进 2 纳米工艺制造逻辑芯片的交易，并补充说它一直在与大型科技客户就代工合同进行谈判。

title: First Tesla Semi rolls off high volume production line
title_zh: 第一条 Tesla Semi 下线大批量生产线
summary: April 29 (Reuters) - Tesla said on Wednesday its first Semi truck has begun rolling off a high-volume production line as the electric vehicle maker remains on track to launch large-scale manufacturing
summary_zh: 路透 4 月 29 日 - 特斯拉周三表示，其第一辆 Semi 卡车已开始从大批量生产线上下线，这家电动汽车制造商仍有望启动大规模生产。

title_zh: 马斯克对 OpenAI 的财务承诺进行了辩护

title: AI-Led Rally in Asia Stocks Masks Deeper Damage from Iran War
title_zh: 人工智能引领的亚洲股市上涨掩盖了伊朗战争造成的更严重损害
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Asia’s artificial intelligence-fueled rally is masking signs of strain, with gains in tech names overshadowing the impact of the US-Iran war on the broader market.Most Read from BloombergNorth Korea Confirms Suicide Rule for Soldiers Ukraine CapturesUAE Quits OP...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——亚洲人工智能推动的涨势掩盖了紧张的迹象，科技股的上涨掩盖了美伊战争对更广泛市场的影响。彭博社的大多数报道朝鲜确认士兵自杀规则乌克兰占领阿联酋退出行动...

title: Samsung Electronics sees robust AI demand after Q1 profit surges eightfold to set record
title_zh: 第一季度利润飙升八倍创纪录后，三星电子看到了强劲的人工智能需求
summary: SEOUL, April 30 () - Samsung Electronics said on Thursday its operating profit jumped eightfold to a record ‌in the first quarter, underpinned by higher chip ‌prices as an artificial intelligence boom led to a supply crunch.
summary_zh: 首尔，4 月 30 日 () - 三星电子周四表示，由于人工智能繁荣导致供应紧缩，芯片价格上涨，该公司第一季度营业利润跃升八倍，创历史新高。

title: Samsung Electronics sees robust AI demand after Q1 chip profit jumps almost 50-fold
title_zh: 三星电子第一季度芯片利润增长近 50 倍，人工智能需求强劲
summary: Samsung Electronics on Thursday reported record quarterly profit driven by a 49-fold jump in chip income, saying it expects the momentum to continue as clients spend on AI infrastructure ‌and drive up prices of its memory chips.
summary_zh: 三星电子周四公布了创纪录的季度利润，芯片收入增长了 49 倍，并表示，随着客户在人工智能基础设施上的支出并推高其存储芯片的价格，预计这一势头将持续下去。

title: Highlights from Meta's earnings call
title_zh: Meta 财报电话会议的亮点
summary: Meta Platforms (META) outpaced estimates on first quarter earnings — posting a profit of $10.44 per share vs. expectations of $8.15 — while also raising its full-year capex spending forecasts to between $125 billion and $145 billion as it expects to invest more in AI.
summary_zh: Meta Platforms (META) 第一季​​度盈利超出预期——每股利润为 10.44 美元，而预期为 8.15 美元——同时还将全年资本支出预测上调至 1250 亿美元至 1450 亿美元之间，因为预计将加大对人工智能的投资。

title: Stock market today: S&P 500, Nasdaq, Dow futures mixed with earnings season in full swing, Fed in focus
title_zh: 今日股市：标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克指数、道琼斯指数期货涨跌互现，财报季节如火如荼，美联储成为焦点
summary: The major gauges were pulled up by tech stocks, down by other industries as Mag 7 earnings dominate headlines.
summary_zh: 主要指标受到科技股的拉升，而其他行业则下跌，因为 Mag 7 的盈利占据了头条新闻。

title: Amazon’s AI spending boom is eating into free cash flow
title_zh: 亚马逊的人工智能支出热潮正在侵蚀自由现金流
summary: Amazon is making more cash from its businesses, but it’s spending almost all of it on AI infrastructure.
summary_zh: 亚马逊从其业务中赚取了更多现金，但它几乎将所有现金都花在了人工智能基础设施上。
